title: Persist Asset Acquisition preflight failures
description: Ensure Asset Acquisition certification and credential preflight failures persist as actionable failed stage runs instead of leaving the downstream production checkpoint waiting forever.
businessContext: The VOX runtime can reject before creating an Asset Acquisition StageRun, leaving the project at not_started while the simplified smoke waits for Scene Review. The user-facing production state must expose a safe retryable failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Asset Acquisition preflight failures persist the stage as failed with a safe reason and a retry route before the IPC call rejects.
A preflight failure creates a failed StageRun without exposing credentials or raw provider exceptions.
Successful Asset Acquisition behavior and provider-backed media validation remain unchanged.
Focused orchestrator checks, typecheck, and diff check pass.
humanEscalationConditions: Persisting the failure would require weakening provider certification or credential safety gates.
